about_the_game:
Kifaru Reign is a low-poly animal survival multiplayer game that brings the wild to life. Step into the role of different animals and experience the challenges of survival in a living, breathing savanna. Hunt, scavenge, form packs, or go solo as you adapt to the harsh environment filled with danger, competition, and opportunity.

In Kifaru Reign, survival is about more than just staying alive — it’s about thriving as part of the ecosystem. Manage hunger, thirst, and energy while exploring open landscapes designed for exploration, strategy, and unexpected encounters.

Key Features:

Animal Survival: Play as different animals, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and abilities. From the cunning hyena to other wild creatures, survival depends on how you adapt.

Multiplayer Experience: Join friends or face off against others in an open world where cooperation and rivalry shape your journey. Work as a pack, or fight to establish dominance on your own.

Core Survival Systems: Balance hunger, thirst, and energy while avoiding predators, finding food, and enduring the environment. Every choice matters for your survival.

Expanding Roster: More animals will be added over time, each introducing new survival styles and interactions within the ecosystem.

Immersive Low-Poly World: Explore the savanna in a stylized, low-poly art style that captures the beauty of nature in a unique and creative way.

Community-Driven Development: Kifaru Reign will grow with your feedback. From new animals to mechanics, the community will help shape the final vision of the game.

Kifaru Reign delivers a survival experience where nature is both your greatest ally and your fiercest enemy. Whether you band together with others or carve your own path, every play session is a story of adaptation, resilience, and the fight to reign supreme in the wild.

🐾 Step into the wild and claim your place in Kifaru Reign!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX660 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i9
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
